Market today: The market's reacting to election results, with a slide in Treasury yields. This is a mixed bag for your concentrated tech/chip book, especially with leverage.
Your holdings: SMCI (-30.81%), MU (-45.86%), and SOXL (-69.8%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. Your leveraged ETF positions are taking a beating, amplified by margin.
Watch: Keep an eye on the leveraged ETF decay and your stop levels, especially on SMCI and SOXL.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting capital from further drawdowns.
plays: Consider trimming SMCI if it breaks below its stop at 37.3.
Evaluate reducing exposure to MU and SOXL if they continue to fall.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
